filename: Machine‐Assisted Physical Closure for Coarse SuspendedSediments in Vegetated Turbulent Channel Flows.pdf
title: Machine‐Assisted Physical Closure for Coarse Suspended Sediments in Vegetated Turbulent Channel Flows
parameterization_target: turbulent dispersive sediment flux ratio (1 - Cg) / (1 - Cf)
testbed_rationale: Small laboratory flume dataset consisting of 9 experimental vertical profile runs; no dedicated code repository provided.
pain_points: Sparsity of experimental vertical concentration profiles requiring artificial data augmentation and interpolation
Lack of varied particle sizes in laboratory data to isolate particle diameter impacts from settling velocity
Restriction to emergent rigid vegetation, limiting immediate generalizability to submerged canopies or real-world natural rivers
extraction_notes: The neural network is embedded directly inside a 4th-order Runge-Kutta differential equation solver to parameterize the dispersive flux ratio from spatial averaging.
